A1.justification: Both PDFs describe SoMA. Their text, equations, figures, tables and appendices A–C are readable and can be matched despite added discussion and renumbered tables.

before.justification: V1 reports original real-world manipulation experiments, baseline comparisons and ablations in Tables 1–3 and the appendices, including evaluation on PhysTwin data.

after.justification: V2 retains these original experiments, including resimulation, unseen-manipulation generalization, T-shirt folding and appendix results.

M1.justification: Equation (9) adds timestep dt to the stated inputs of the velocity/rotation predictor, alongside historical states and interaction force. This is a limited input-specification revision; the architecture, force composition, training procedure and loss formulas remain unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate rope, cloth, doll and T-shirt robot manipulation, plus the hand-trajectory-controlled PhysTwin datasets in Appendix C.3. Resimulation, unseen manipulation and folding coverage are retained.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains PhysTwin and GausSim; the T-shirt and PhysTwin-dataset comparisons retain PhysTwin. V2's additional methods in Table 5 are descriptive related-work comparisons, not newly evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: The 7:3 split, sequence counts, 640×480 capture at 30 FPS, rollout procedures, RGB/depth metrics and masking rules are unchanged. Appendix B retains the same training settings and baseline adaptations.

E4.justification: Table 3 retains the joint-training, image-only and multi-resolution-training ablations. Temporal-stride sensitivity results move from Table 6 to Table 7 unchanged, and the qualitative cases in Figures 3–4 are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests. Averaging across frames and evaluation scenarios remains unchanged.

E6.justification: Benchmark and ablation values and qualitative results are unchanged, including Tables 1–3 and the PhysTwin results in v1 Table 7/v2 Table 8. However, Appendix B.2 removes the approximately 12 FPS inference result without a replacement.

T1.justification: No theorem, proof or derivation is added or revised. The hierarchical mathematics and regularizer in Equation (13) remain unchanged; its momentum-to-mass conservation description changes the interpretation without supplying a different mathematical argument.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions and conclusion retain the same claims about action-conditioned Gaussian-splat simulation, learned dynamics without predefined physical models, long-horizon stability and generalization. The headline 20% improvement claim is unchanged.

C2.justification: Section 4.2.4 describes the unchanged regularizer as enforcing mass rather than momentum conservation. V2 also removes the conclusion's explicit reconstruction-quality, severe-occlusion and unfamiliar-contact limitations; the appendix's evaluation-scale limitations remain, moving from A.2 to A.3.

D1.justification: Appendix B.2 deletes inference-throughput information. The H200 hardware, four training GPUs, single inference GPU, approximately 24-hour first-stage training, network specifications, preprocessing and project-page information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: New Appendix A.2 and Table 5 substantially expand method-level positioning through comparisons of action conditioning, supervision, representation and rendering. They introduce coverage of 3DGSim, VPD/HD-VPD and DeformContact alongside previously discussed methods. TC4D, Align Your Gaussians and Warp references are removed; publication updates for retained works do not constitute new methods.

P1.justification: V2 makes targeted spelling and terminology edits, replaces the template running header, updates author/publication formatting, adds acknowledgments and separates the impact statement. Appendix A gains a subsection, but the main exposition and section order remain largely intact.

P2.justification: V2 adds comparison Table 5, removes the Source of Consistency row from Table 4 and revises its labels. Table 3 changes column placement, appendix tables are renumbered and reflowed, and Figure 4's caption is corrected. The four figures retain their visual content.

improvement.justification: Appendix A.2 and Table 5 make the research positioning more specific, and presentation receives useful corrections. However, v2 removes explicit failure-condition caveats and the inference-speed report while retaining the same benchmark evidence. These gains in contextualization and losses in disclosure do not establish a reliable net direction in overall quality.
